frozenOrb.radialEmission: travelling orb emits rotating frozenorbbolt and finishes with frozenorbnova; not one homing projectile

energyShield.manaExhaustion: Absorption is capped at available mana / manaPerDamage; unabsorbed remainder damages HP and zero mana ends shield.

coldArmorRetaliation.frozenArmor: successful melee hit freezes attacker; no retaliatory damage
coldArmorRetaliation.shiverArmor: melee attack attempt triggers cold damage/chill even if attack misses
coldArmorRetaliation.chillingArmor: ranged missile attack triggers retaliatory chillingarmorbolt; do not also apply melee armor retaliation

mechanics.timedDelaySemantics: LoD1.13 uses a shared timed-skill casting delay, distinct from spell casting animation; do not use D2R2.4 independent cooldowns.

staticField.scope: Original difficulty floor applies to all monsters; a custom boss-only floor in this game is an explicit adaptation. Lightning resistance still applies.

behaviorReferences.scope: Reverse-engineered original engine behavior corroboration, not a replacement for 1.13 table values. HydraSrvDo144 explicitly summons3. ES EventFunc24 excludes poison. Armor EventFuncs1/2/3 implement separate triggers.
